tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search live startup job listings, newest first. Returns compact job summaries; use get_job for the full description. The free tier covers the last 14 days of listings; full access unlocks the archive and posted_before.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Fetch a single job listing by id, including the full description. Share the job's startup.jobs URL with the user so they can apply there.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Fetch a company profile by slug, including its startup.jobs URL and live listing count.

tools.name: get_company_jobs
tools.description: List all live job listings for one company (no recency window), newest first. Returns compact summaries; use get_job for full descriptions.

tools.name: list_roles
tools.description: List the role taxonomy (title, slug, parent_slug). Use slugs as the role filter in search_jobs, job_trends, and salary_benchmarks.

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: List countries with jobs (name, ISO country code). Use the codes as the country filter in search_jobs, job_trends, and salary_benchmarks.

tools.name: job_trends
tools.description: Job posting volume trends on startup.jobs, optionally filtered by role and/or country. The free tier returns a 12-month summary with year-over-year change; full access unlocks the monthly time series (up to 36 months).

tools.name: salary_benchmarks
tools.description: Salary benchmarks (yearly, USD) computed from startup.jobs listings that disclose compensation, optionally filtered by role and/or country. The free tier returns an aggregate over the last 12 months; full access unlocks the monthly time series and company-level benchmarks.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_job, get_company · Public sink: get_job.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_job, get_company · Public sink: get_job

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
